activity_summary: You had played Two Gentlemen. Nick came on the whistle once, and John heard that he was not late. Augustine says the Rose is still dark, and he has no figure for it. You refused the figure. Garnish still has the king. You are not counting his leaves. Kemp's noise about the roads was reported and not answered. You are going home by the same road, with nothing in your hands.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Called the afternoon the right size, refused a sum, and went.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Reported one clean entrance, and went toward Aldermanbury.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Stopped a second run, and said the Rose flag was not up.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Confirmed the boy was not late, and parked the roads.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Busy is the right size of an afternoon

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Their house is shut. Ours was open
